# VPAT evidence appendix

The automated half of the evidence behind [docs/legal/vpat.md](vpat.md): what the accessibility gate scans and what it found. Read from [`e2e/a11y-baseline.json`](https://github.com/21072026/Internship/blob/b65ca8e6fa0701df05367ed5f5249ef90b90160f/e2e/a11y-baseline.json) as last changed in commit `b65ca8e` on 2026-10-21, from `docs/a11y-audit.md` and from the gate's configuration in `e2e/a11y-scan.spec.ts`; generated at commit `b161bed`.

## Rule set and gate

- axe-core tags: `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`
- Severities that fail a pull request: `critical`, `serious` (moderate and minor findings are reported in `docs/a11y-audit.md` but never gate)
- Report totals at the last regenerate: critical: 0 · serious: 0 · moderate: 0 · minor: 0

## Page states scanned (50)

A page is scanned once per theme; `:param` segments are route patterns the scan fills with a seeded record. "clean" means no critical or serious violation is frozen in the baseline for that page state; anything else lists the frozen rule ids and counts, which the gate tolerates until they are fixed.

## How to regenerate

```bash
A11Y_UPDATE_BASELINE=1 npx playwright test e2e/a11y-scan.spec.ts   # re-measure (needs a database)
npm run vpat:evidence                                             # rewrite this appendix and docs/legal/vpat.md
npm run test:unit -- scripts/test/vpat.test.mjs                   # the drift and "Supports needs evidence" checks
```

Whenever `e2e/a11y-baseline.json` changes, the regenerate above runs in the same pull request and the affected VPAT rows are re-reviewed (`docs/legal/README.md`).
